english.title: Export veterinary medicinal product to member State when it may not lawfully be supplied / administered there
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) exported a veterinary medicinal product, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..), for use in a member State, namely **(..SPECIFY STATE..), when the product may not have been lawfully supplied or administered in that member State
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 31(1), 43(t) and 44 of the Veterinary Medicines Regulations 2013.

english.notes: This offence should not be used after the 31st December 2020 due to changes made by SI 2019/676 Veterinary Medicines and Animals and Animal Products (Examination of Residues and Maximum Residue Limits) (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019. For the offence applicable after this date, see H101687.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 282(2) and (3) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.
